blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A labor group and a health reform advocate have urged the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) to reconsider its planned 20% hospital benefit top-up for regular contributors, arguing that basing additional coverage on contribution records could undermine the principle of equal protection under the country’s universal health care system.
